title: Reading Lab Reports — Blood Tests That Change Your Treatment

hook.en: A blood test can tell you that a patient is anaemic, infected, dehydrated, bleeding or on blood thinners, all of which change what exercise is safe. Learn the common tests and how to use them.
hook.ur: Blood test batata hai ke mareez mein khoon ki kami, infection, paani ki kami, bleeding ya khoon patla karne ki dawai hai, jo sab badalte hain ke kaun si exercise mehfooz hai. Aam tests aur unka istemal seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll read a basic lab report, know the usual ranges and the meaning of the common tests (blood count, inflammation, sugar, kidney and salts, clotting) and decide when a result limits exercise or needs the doctor.
goal.ur: End tak aap basic lab report parhenge, aam ranges aur aam tests (blood count, sozish, sugar, gurda aur namkiyat, jamne) ka matlab jaanenge aur faisla karenge ke nateeja kab exercise ko mehdood karta hai ya doctor chahiye.

text.en: A lab report lists each test, the **result**, the **unit** and a **reference range** (the usual range for healthy people in that lab). Results outside the range are **flagged**. A flag is **not a diagnosis**: many results are slightly out of range in healthy people, and the same result means different things in different patients. Physiotherapists use labs to **decide whether it is safe to exercise, to spot warning signs and to talk with the medical team**. Always use the lab's own ranges, and look at the **trend**, not only one result.
text.ur: Lab report har test, **nateeja**, **unit** aur **reference range** (us lab mein sehatmand logon ki aam range) likhti hai. Range se bahar ke nateeje **flag** hote hain. Flag **tashkhees nahi**: sehatmand logon mein bhi bohat se nateeje thore range se bahar hote hain, aur ek hi nateeja mukhtalif mareezon mein mukhtalif maani rakhta hai. Physiotherapist labs istemal karte hain **yeh tay karne ke liye ke exercise mehfooz hai ya nahi, warning signs pakarne ke liye aur medical team se baat karne ke liye**. Hamesha lab ki apni ranges istemal karein, aur sirf ek nateeje nahi **rujhan** dekhein.

text.en: Think of a lab report as **a car's dashboard**. A warning light tells you something needs checking, but you must read it in context: a low fuel light before a long trip matters more than before a short one. Likewise, a low haemoglobin matters more before heavy exercise than before gentle walking. A good driver checks the whole dashboard and the road.
text.ur: Lab report ko **gaari ka dashboard** samjhein. Warning light batati hai ke kuch check karna hai, magar usay sahi nazariye se parhna hota hai: lambay safar se pehle tel ki kami chhote safar se zyada ahem hai. Isi tarah halki chahal-qadmi se pehle kam haemoglobin se zyada bhaari exercise se pehle kam haemoglobin ahem hai. Achha driver poora dashboard aur sarak dono dekhta hai.

title.ur: Lab report ko mehfooz tareeqe se istemal karna

steps.title: Check the basics
steps.detail: Name, date and time, the lab's reference ranges and the units. Mixing up units (for example mg/dL and mmol/L) is a common error. || Buniyadi cheezein check karein

steps.title: Read the key tests
steps.detail: Blood count (haemoglobin, white cells, platelets), inflammation markers (CRP, ESR), glucose or HbA1c, kidney function and salts (urea, creatinine, eGFR, sodium, potassium), clotting (INR) and others the doctor ordered. || Aham tests parhein

steps.title: Look at the trend and the patient
steps.detail: Compare with earlier results, and with how the patient looks and feels today. A falling haemoglobin matters more than a steady slightly low one. || Rujhan aur mareez dekhein

steps.title: Decide: go, modify or hold
steps.detail: Use your unit's limits and the medical team's advice to continue, modify or stop exercise, and tell the doctor about worrying results. Record your decision. || Faisla: chalein, badlein ya rokein

question.en: Which result raises the concern of anaemia?
question.ur: Kaun sa nateeja khoon ki kami ki fikr barhata hai?

feedback.en: Yes — haemoglobin carries oxygen, so low levels can cause tiredness and breathlessness.
feedback.ur: Haan — haemoglobin oxygen le jata hai, is liye kam hone par thakan aur saans ki tangi ho sakti hai.

title.en: Common blood tests and typical adult ranges (your lab's range comes first)
title.ur: Aam blood tests aur aam bale logon ki ranges (pehle aap ki lab ki range)

headers.en: Why it matters to a physiotherapist

rows.en: About 13 to 17 g/dL in men, 12 to 15.5 g/dL in women
rows.ur: Mardon mein takreeban 13 se 17 g/dL, khawateen mein 12 se 15.5 g/dL

rows.en: Low: tiredness, breathlessness, a lower exercise limit
rows.ur: Kam: thakan, saans ki tangi, kam exercise ki hadd

rows.en: High: infection or stress; very low: infection risk
rows.ur: Zyada: infection ya dabao; bohat kam: infection ka khatra

rows.en: Low: bleeding and bruising risk, avoid heavy resistance and contact work
rows.ur: Kam: bleeding aur neel ka khatra, bhaari resistance aur contact kaam se bachein

rows.en: High: inflammation or infection; use with the whole picture
rows.ur: Zyada: sozish ya infection; poori tasveer ke saath istemal karein

rows.en: Under 5.7 percent normal; 6.5 percent or more suggests diabetes
rows.ur: 5.7 percent se kam normal; 6.5 percent ya zyada diabetes batata hai

rows.en: Poor control raises risk with exercise, wounds and feet
rows.ur: Kamzor qaboo exercise, zakhmon aur pairon mein khatra barhata hai

rows.en: Too high or low can cause dangerous heart rhythms
rows.ur: Bohat zyada ya kam khatarnak dil ki rhythm paida kar sakta hai

rows.en: About 1 in people not on warfarin; the target is usually 2 to 3 on warfarin
rows.ur: Warfarin na lene walon mein takreeban 1; warfarin par aam taur par 2 se 3 target

rows.en: High: bleeding risk, avoid falls and heavy manual techniques
rows.ur: Zyada: bleeding ka khatra, girne aur bhaari manual techniques se bachein

text.en: **Range, trend, patient.** A single result outside the range is only a prompt. Check the lab's range, look at the trend and look at the patient before you decide. When a result could harm, ask the doctor.
text.ur: **Range, rujhan, mareez.** Range se bahar ek nateeja sirf ishara hai. Lab ki range, rujhan aur mareez dekh kar faisla karein. Nateeja nuqsan de sakta ho to doctor se poochhein.

text.en: **Quoting a result as a diagnosis, or changing medicines.** A physiotherapist should not diagnose from a lab or advise a change of medicine. Report the finding and its effect on exercise, and let the doctor interpret it and decide on treatment. Respect the patient's privacy when handling results.
text.ur: **Nateeje ko tashkhees ki tarah batana ya dawaiyan badalna.** Physiotherapist ko lab se tashkhees ya dawai badalne ka mashwara nahi dena chahiye. Finding aur exercise par is ka asar report karein, aur doctor ko tabeer aur ilaj ka faisla karne dein. Nateejon ko sambhalte hue mareez ki raaz daari ka khayal rakhein.

question.en: A patient's potassium is 6.2 mmol/L. What should you do?
question.ur: Mareez ka potassium 6.2 mmol/L hai. Aap kya karein?

text.en: Encourage a longer walk to flush it out
text.ur: Is ko nikalne ke liye lambi chahal-qadmi karwayein

text.en: Do not exercise and tell the medical team at once
text.ur: Exercise na karwayein aur foran medical team ko batayein

feedback.en: Yes — a high potassium can cause serious heart rhythm problems.
feedback.ur: Haan — zyada potassium dil ki rhythm ke sangeen masail paida kar sakta hai.

text.en: Advise the patient to stop a medicine
text.ur: Mareez ko dawai band karne ka kahein

feedback.en: Only the doctor decides on medicines.
feedback.ur: Sirf doctor dawaiyon ka faisla karta hai.

question.en: A patient on warfarin has an INR of 4.5 and wants a deep tissue massage. What is best?
question.ur: Warfarin lene wale mareez ka INR 4.5 hai aur woh deep tissue malish chahta hai. Behtareen kya hai?

text.en: Tell the patient to take extra vitamin K
text.ur: Mareez ko zyada vitamin K lene ko kahein

text.en: Avoid deep or forceful techniques and tell the medical team about the high INR
text.ur: Gehri ya zor wali techniques se bachein aur zyada INR ke baare mein medical team ko batayein

feedback.en: Yes — a high INR raises the bleeding risk.
feedback.ur: Haan — zyada INR bleeding ka khatra barhata hai.

text.en: Go ahead; INR does not matter
text.ur: Karein; INR se farq nahi parta

feedback.en: It can cause serious bruising or bleeding.
feedback.ur: Isse sangeen neel ya bleeding ho sakti hai.

text.en: **Ask the right question.** Before a session, ask: "Have any new blood tests come back, and is there anything I should know for today's exercise?" Keep a short note of the key results for patients with heart, kidney, diabetes or blood-thinner issues, and update it after each review.
text.ur: **Sahi sawal poochhein.** Session se pehle poochhein: "Kya koi naye blood tests aaye hain, aur aaj ki exercise ke liye mujhe kuch jaanna chahiye?" Dil, gurde, diabetes ya khoon patla karne ki dawai wale mareezon ke aham nateejon ka mukhtasar note rakhein aur har review ke baad update karein.

question.en: Why should you use the lab's own reference range?
question.ur: Lab ki apni reference range kyun istemal karni chahiye?

answer.en: Different labs use different methods, equipment and populations, so ranges and sometimes units differ. A result that is normal in one lab can be flagged in another. The range printed on the report is the right yardstick for that result.
answer.ur: Mukhtalif labs mukhtalif tareeqe, aalat aur aabadi istemal karti hain, is liye ranges aur kabhi units mukhtalif hote hain. Ek lab mein normal nateeja doosri mein flag ho sakta hai. Report par chhapi range us nateeje ka sahi paimana hai.

beats.patient: A 72-year-old woman on a cardiac rehabilitation programme becomes more breathless on her usual walk. Her blood test shows haemoglobin 8.5 g/dL (it was 12 two months ago) and she looks pale.
beats.assessment: A falling haemoglobin with pallor and increased breathlessness suggests anaemia, possibly from bleeding, and needs medical review before more exercise.
beats.treatment: Stop the session, record observations, report the blood result and symptoms to the medical team and hold exercise until they have reviewed her.
beats.reassess: The doctor finds a cause and treats it; she resumes rehabilitation once her haemoglobin recovers.

text.en: **Report to the doctor straight away** for severe anaemia, a very low platelet count, a very high or low potassium or sodium, very high glucose with unwellness, a high INR with bruising or bleeding, or signs of infection with raised white cells and fever. Do not start or progress exercise on these results without medical clearance. Never advise a change of medicines.
text.ur: **Foran doctor ko batayein** shadeed anaemia, bohat kam platelets, bohat zyada ya kam potassium ya sodium, beemari ke saath bohat zyada glucose, neel ya bleeding ke saath zyada INR, ya zyada white cells aur bukhar ke saath infection ki nishaniyan. In nateejon par medical ijazat ke baghair exercise shuru ya tez na karein. Dawaiyon ki tabdeeli ka mashwara kabhi na dein.

summary.en: A lab report gives the result, unit and reference range; a flag is not a diagnosis, and trends and the patient matter more than one number.
summary.ur: Lab report nateeja, unit aur reference range deti hai; flag tashkhees nahi, aur ek number se zyada rujhan aur mareez ahem hain.

summary.en: Know the key tests: haemoglobin, white cells, platelets, CRP, HbA1c, potassium and INR, and how each changes what exercise or technique is safe.
summary.ur: Aham tests jaanein: haemoglobin, white cells, platelets, CRP, HbA1c, potassium aur INR, aur har ek exercise ya technique ki hifazat kaise badalta hai.

summary.en: Report worrying results to the doctor, hold exercise when needed and never diagnose or change medicines.
summary.ur: Fikr wale nateeje doctor ko batayein, zaroorat par exercise rokein aur kabhi tashkhees ya dawaiyan na badlein.
